summary: Exploratory recipe search on visible validation, in one call. Either a typed template (config.template: {name: quick|broad, task_type?, preprocess?, families?, finalists?, cv_folds?, seeds?, rank_by?}) that crosses preprocessing (none, train-fitted standardize, per_example_center, per_example_standardize) with model families (linear ridge/logistic, knn, kernel ridge, small mlp; svm and gbm when scikit-learn is importable) on NPZ train and validation ports (x, y), screens every recipe on validation and cross-validates the best finalists within train, with no authored code; or a project command run once per recipe x seed x fold in a private work dir: config.command.argv ("python" or an absolute path first; {work} {out} {seed} {fold} {folds} {params_json} {recipe} and {param.NAME} substituted), which writes numeric metrics to {out}/receipt.json, with config.space (grid or random with a seed), config.seed_policy, config.budget (max_trials or max_seconds) and config.stopping (none, patience or target). Outputs: evidence_table (every attempted recipe, ranked, with its metrics) and best_recipe. Without a source bundle, config.command.copy must list the project files to copy. Each evaluation runs in a scrubbed environment and its own process group. No claim and no test data; lock the winner before independent confirmation.

files.description: optional port->plain filename map; ports not listed are staged as <port><ext>

copy.description: plain file names copied from the project directory into each work dir; required without a source bundle. Nothing is copied implicitly, and a file named after a test or held-out split is refused.

metrics_file.description: JSON object of numeric metrics written under {out}; default receipt.json

recipe.description: optional recipe template: any JSON, with {"$param": NAME} replaced, written to {recipe} in the work dir

parameters.description: name -> {values: [...]}, or for random also {low, high, log?, integer?}

metric.description: a visible-validation metric from the command's receipt, e.g. validation_accuracy; a test or held-out metric is refused

folds.description: folds of the visible data; the command reads {fold} of {folds} and owns the split

budget.description: at least one of max_trials (recipes) and max_seconds; with a template, default max_trials = the template's recipe count

template.description: a typed recipe template instead of command/space/objective/recipe: needs train and validation NPZ ports (x, y); no source bundle

name.description: quick: one setting per family; broad: two or three

task_type.description: default: the task input's task_type; objective validation_accuracy (maximize) or validation_rmse (minimize)

finalists.description: best screened recipes cross-validated within train; default 3

rank_by.description: how the best finalist is chosen; default validation (train-CV cannot see a train-validation shift)

max_rows.description: training-row cap for kernel, svm and gbm
